annotation.title_clean: Real Decreto 1036/2017, de 15 de diciembre, por el que se regula la utilización civil de las aeronaves pilotadas por control remoto
annotation.title_en: Royal Decree 1036/2017 of 15 December regulating the civil use of remotely piloted aircraft
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de la Presidencia y para las Administraciones Territoriales (Spain), published in BOE
annotation.summary_en: Spanish Royal Decree 1036/2017 sets the legal regime for civil remotely piloted aircraft (drones) outside EU rules: identification, airworthiness, airspace conditions, operator duties, insurance, pilot qualifications, and prior notification or authorisation by AESA. Autonomous aircraft are not permitted. Consolidated page notes it was repealed from 25 June 2024 by RD 517/2024.
key_provisions_or_claims: Pilot must be able to intervene in flight at all times; autonomous aircraft are not permitted in Spanish airspace
Operators need aeronautical safety study, third-party liability insurance, and data-protection compliance
Prior notification to AESA for RPA up to 25 kg; authorisation for heavier, BVLOS, controlled airspace or night flights
Remote pilots must be 18+, hold medical certificate and theoretical and practical training
Restrictions on overflight of critical infrastructure and urban areas; repealed from 25 June 2024 by RD 517/2024
